leads.title: Equal Opportunity Act 2010 (Vic) - incl. Equal Opportunity (Gender Identity and Sexual Orientation) Act 2000
leads.documents: Core Victorian discrimination protection on basis of sexual orientation and gender identity; since 2021 explicitly added sex characteristics; 2022 amendment explicitly protects Victoria Police officers on duty on same grounds.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: Equal Opportunity (Gender Identity and Sexual Orientation) Act 2000 amending Equal Opportunity Act 1995; replaced by Equal Opportunity Act 2010; Justice Legislation Amendment (Police and Other Matters) Bill 2022 passed September 2022

leads.title: Sex Discrimination Amendment (Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity and Intersex Status) Act 2013 (Cth)
leads.documents: Federal anti-discrimination protection for LGBT and Intersex people applicable in Victoria.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as federal law protecting LGBT and Intersex people in Victoria

leads.title: Change or Suppression (Conversion) Practices Prohibition Bill 2020 / Act
leads.documents: Bans conversion practices in Victoria with fines up to ~$200,000 AUD or up to 10 years jail; described as most comprehensive conversion therapy ban at the time.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: introduced/printed November 2020, passed lower house Dec 2020 by 55-0, passed Legislative Council 5 Feb 2021 by 27-9 after 12-hour debate, effective 1 year after royal assent (Feb 2022)

leads.title: Health Complaints Bill 2016 / Health Complaints Commissioner
leads.documents: First-stage Victorian crackdown on gay conversion therapists; creates Health Complaints Commissioner with powers to issue warnings and ban unregistered providers; targeted investigation launched May 2018.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: introduced 9 Feb 2016, passed lower house 25 Feb 2016, upper house 14 April 2016, royal assent 5 May 2016, effective 1 Feb 2017

leads.title: Justice Legislation Amendment (Anti-vilification and Social Cohesion) Bill / Anti-vilification Act
leads.documents: Expands anti-vilification/incitement laws to include disability, gender identity, sex, sex characteristics, sexual orientation; max 5 years imprisonment; includes political/religious/academic exemptions.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: introduced Nov 2024 as printed, passed both houses April 2025 / March 2025, royal assent 8 April 2025, effective 30 June 2026

leads.title: Re McBain v State of Victoria (2000) - Federal Court, Justice Sundberg
leads.documents: Held Victorian Infertility (Medical Procedures) Act 1984 marriage requirement infringed s22 Sex Discrimination Act prohibition on discrimination; opened IVF to lesbian couples.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: re McBain v State of Victoria, 28 July 2000, re ss 11,12,13 Infertility (Medical Procedures) Act 1984 and s22 Sex Discrimination Act

leads.title: Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act 2006 and 2010 Supreme Court of Victoria adoption decision
leads.documents: 2010 Supreme Court decision under the Charter held Adoption Act 1984 permits one person in same-sex couple to adopt, opening step-parent adoption.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: Supreme Court of Victoria decision in 2010 concerning Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act 2006 and Adoption Act 1984

leads.title: Equal Opportunity (Religious Exceptions) Amendment Bill 2021 / Act
leads.documents: Narrows religious exemptions; prohibits religious schools/orgs discriminating against employees on sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status; government-funded bodies barred from refusing services; effective 15 June 2022.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: introduced Oct 2021, passed both houses Dec 2021 despite Liberal/National/Liberal Democratic/Shooters Fishers Farmers/Cumming opposition, royal assent Dec 2021

leads.title: Supreme Court of Victoria August 2024 puberty blockers ruling
leads.documents: Upheld ruling allowing puberty blockers for transgender children with stress and anxiety; key transgender healthcare enforcement precedent.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: Supreme Court of Victoria, August 2024

leads.title: Commissioner for LGBTIQ+ Communities (Gender and Sexuality Commissioner) and Victorian Equal Opportunity and Human Rights Commission
leads.documents: Victoria-only LGBTIQA+ Commissioner rights machinery to integrate LGBTI rights, align passports/birth certificates, strengthen workplace protections; VEOHRC (est. 1975) enforces Equal Opportunity Act; reported April 2025 budget cuts risking case backlog.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: appointment July 2015 by Equality Minister Martin Foley, inaugural holder Ro Allen; Star Observer Sept 2021 / media April 2025 reporting
